source.stem:
Aluminium is used to make containers for storing food.

Which property makes it suitable for this use?

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Once the trunks are cut, nothing holds the soil together, even if all the roots remain intact.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Fresh leaves left behind by forest cutting immediately become new soil without decomposing.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Removing the forest plants and their roots reduces soil washing away because roots loosen the soil.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Normal seasonal leaf fall harms forest soil and removes animals' food and shelter just like cutting down the forest.

intelligence.enrichment: Plant roots hold soil and prevent it from being washed away. Leaves on the ground and decomposing plants and animals become part of soil, so cutting forests on a large scale harms soil quality and removes food and shelter for animals. When trees and other forest plants are removed, roots no longer hold soil in the same way, leaf cover and decomposition decrease, and animals lose the forest support they depended on. The learner correctly applies this rule: Plant roots hold soil and prevent it from being washed away. Leaves on the ground and decomposing plants and animals become part of soil, so cutting forests on a large scale harms soil quality and removes food and shelter for animals. Cutting trees affects only wood availability, not soil quality or animal living conditions.
